If they want to exchange it, how would that work?

Because everything is custom-made to order, there are no traditional returns or exchanges unless something's defective. Here's how it breaks down:



Defect or wrong size from production: free repair or replacement of the same product within 90 days of purchase, and Select Blinds covers return shipping. 


Measuring mistake: FIT Protection covers a one-time free remake of the same product with corrected measurements, requested within 90 days and within 2 inches of the original size.


Just don't like it (color, style, changed mind): you can request a remake of the same product in the same size at the price paid, plus an additional 10% off, or reorder a different product within 90 days with the original discount plus an extra 10% off.



So if your gift recipient isn't thrilled, they'd have that 90-day window to get a different color or product at a discount.
